title: Bus Stop Description Changes - July 2026
body: A few Bus Stop Descriptions (Names) have been updated in July 2026. Do head over to Settings and re-fetch your bus stop data to get the most up to date information.

title: Fare Review Exercise
body: The Public Transport Fare Review Exercise (FRE) 2026 sees an overall 7.0% increase in bus and train fares with effect from 26th December 2026. Adult card fares for buses and trains are set to increase by 12–13 cents, while Concession card fares (except for Workfare Transport) are set to increase by 5 cents...
